explication: CoreELEC p3i is a custom CoreELEC/Kodi media-center distribution, aimed especially at S922X devices. Its user-facing path is device user to Kodi media playback, with FFmpeg and platform support forming part of the documented core; the README does not specify internal runtime call paths. The tree also contains add-on services and an Amlogic AV1 OBU utility. Edges among the latter are limited to references recorded in the SOURCE INDEX; unsampled add-on behavior is represented only where its source was shown.
